_comment: Bundled vocabulary for the change-control validator (contract requirement 3).
Kept in sync with contract/change-control.schema.json by scripts/check_repo.py.
These are the words a claim may use, never a statement of what anyone must do. No framework
control text, no guidance, no evidence-item list — see contract/README.md, requirement 9.
`sod_rule` is the one worth reading twice. It names the separations a reviewer can be asked
about; it does not assert that any framework requires them. Which of these a given
organization must hold to is Noru's queue to answer, not this file's.
